title: Delete your account
subtitle: Applies to the TricityMatch website and mobile apps
intro: You can delete your TricityMatch account at any time. Your profile is hidden straight away and everything is erased 30 days later. Until then you can sign in and cancel; after that it cannot be undone.

web.i3: Open the Pause or delete tab and choose Delete My Account
web.i4: Confirm with your password (if you signed in with Google, use the email request below instead). To erase everything at once instead of after 30 days, tick Delete immediately
web.i5: Changed your mind? Sign in and choose Cancel deletion on the same tab

app.i1: Open the TricityMatch app and log in
app.i3: Choose Delete account and confirm with your password (the app schedules the deletion for 30 days later; use the website if you want it erased at once)
app.i4: To keep your account, open Settings again and choose Cancel account deletion

cant.p: Email us at <supportmail>{{supportEmail}}</supportmail> from the email address registered to your account (or include the mobile number you signed up with) and request deletion. We will verify it is really you before deleting, and confirm once it is done.

what.i1: Your profile, photos, and partner preferences
what.i2: Your matches, likes, shortlists, and conversations
what.i3: Your verification selfie, if you submitted one
what.i4: Your contact details and notification tokens
what.p: Your profile and this data are erased 30 days after you ask (or immediately if you choose that on the website) — after that it cannot be undone. Limited records (for example payment/invoice records, or data connected to a safety report) are retained where the law requires it or to prevent fraud and abuse, as described in our <privacylink>Privacy Policy</privacylink>.
